coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .gitignore and use-system-python-packages.patch due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors.
learnings: Transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) should be distinguished from actual security inconclusiveness. The audit tool could implement automatic retries for API failures before marking a file or the whole package as inconclusive.
